notes.title: Demo feedback update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ːtinyloveː

First, we would like to thank everyone who played the [b]Demo[/b] during the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration. ːgachaexcitedː

Special thanks to everyone who took the time to provide us detailed feedback, [b]it has been so helpful to improve the game experience and to make sure we hear our community[/b]! Thank you!! ːgachaloveː

At this moment, we keep working on the game as much as we can to ensure you have an updated version of the DEMO for the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fes[/b]t. 

So, as part of the results here are the things that will be included for [b]Steam Next Fest Demo[/b]: 

[b]Features[/b]: 
[list]
[*] Added [b]“Hint"[/b] system feature, note that hint system will not reveal hidden collectibles, it’s only for differences. 
[*] Added [b]“Photo Mode”[/b] feature
[*] Found differences visibility will [b]persist when you leave the level[/b].
[/list]
[b]Input[/b]: 
[list]
[*] You can now navigate in the level selection scene by holding the mouse left button + movement (Drag). 
[*] You can now PAN the camera view by holding the mouse left button + movement (Drag). Middle mouse button is not used anymore
[*] Zoom out has been increased so you can fully see the whole game level
[*] Rotation has been improved to avoid getting out of the scene
[*] Rotation max speed has been adjusted to avoid super speed when rotating hehe
[/list]
UI:
[list]
[*] Main menu titles are visible with less opacity instead of fully hidden to avoid the player guessing all the menu options.
[/list]
Bugs: 
[list]
[*] Fixed some incorrect gamepad glyphs displaying in the game
[/list]

We might add some other features/improvements in the upcoming weeks but for now these are the main changes based on your last feedback.

Thank you again for providing such precious feedback. ːtinyloveː
